title: 日本ダービーの後に・笑い泣きの栄冠

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite trembling with fear throughout the race, Tamamo Cross wins the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But a sense of relief overpowers the joy of victory. Still reeling from the accident, she obtains this win with a heavy price…
